description: One call for 'what is happening right now' on Robinhood Chain and Solana: the tokens FOMO app traders are gathering on (with PumpPill's read of each), the calls PumpPill's room posted (a few minutes behind unless a member asks), and newly flagged Robinhood Chain tokens.
